name: syncEHRData
shortDescription: Synchronizes patient medical records with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system.
description:
Overview

Synchronizes patient medical records with an external Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. This function facilitates data exchange to keep patient information consistent across hospital systems.

Intended use

This function is intended to be invoked by a scheduler (cron job) to periodically synchronize data with the EHRSystem. It does not require specific parameters for invocation.

Logic

  1. Call the EHRSystem external service using ctx.service('EHRSystem') to fetch new or updated patient medical records.
  2. Iterate through the retrieved EHR data.
  3. For each record, identify the corresponding Patient and MedicalRecord entities in the local system.
  4. Update or create MedicalRecord entries using ctx.data.upsert or ctx.data.create, ensuring data integrity and PHI compliance.
  5. Audit-log the synchronization process with ctx.audit.log, noting any updates or new records.

Entities

  • MedicalRecord
  • Patient

External Services

  • EHRSystem
